segments.name: Lodging
products: Independent boutique hotel in New York
segments.description: A self-advised REIT that owns rooms-focused upscale hotels across the U.S., operated by third-party managers under Marriott, Hilton and other brands.
segments.evidence: The Company has no foreign operations or assets, and its operating structure includes only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns room revenue from hotel guests at its owned hotels, which are operated and managed by third-party hotel management companies under franchise brands.
revenueModel.evidence: Average Daily Rate ("ADR") is calculated as room revenue divided by the number of rooms sold, and revenue per available room ("RevPAR") is calculated as occupancy multiplied by ADR.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company recovered possession of its New York independent boutique hotel and reinstated hotel operations through a third-party manager.
changes.evidence: On April 4, 2025, the Company recovered possession of this property and reinstated operations of the hotel's 209 guest rooms through a third-party manager engaged by the Company.
